text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — spotted ~15 mid-market accounts with steady feature toggles but a sharp drop in scheduled runs over the last 7 days. renewals clustered in 28-30 days. thinking a compact "conservation + downgrade safety net" play.
Arjun Singh: +1. share trigger criteria and I'll loop enablement + support.
Maya Patel: Trigger = 20%+ MAU drop OR 30%+ token consumption drop vs baseline AND renewal within 30 days. Also: any billing alerts -> escalate immediately.
Leo Chen: Add failed onboarding milestone flag (no model rollout/integration test). that pattern predicts churn.
Samir Ortiz: For low-touch: (1) temperature-check email w/ 1-click cal link (2) 15-min troubleshooting call (3) reversible downgrade offer. keep it low-friction.
Maya Patel: Proposed timeline:
- Day 0: automated email + CS task assigned
- Day 2: micro-survey ping if no reply
- Day 4: 15-min troubleshooting call; attach checklist
- Day 7: downgrade offer with 30-day rollback + scheduled enablement
- Day 14: last-chance outreach (prorated credit or EPD for high-risk)
Samir Ortiz: Rollback window is golden. reduces friction to accept downgrade.
Leo Chen: Enablement checklist needed (one-pager): integration probes, quota checks, example prompts, cost/cadence tuning. @Arjun can you own?
Arjun Singh: Yup. I'll draft the checklist + a short triage script. aiming to drop in #docs tomorrow.
Maya Patel: Short email template (keep it terse):
```
Hi {{first_name}},
Noticed a recent dip in usage for {{org_name}} and your renewal is on {{renewal_date}}. Can we grab 15 minutes to help unblock? We can also propose a temporary downgrade with an easy rollback.
—Maya, Customer Success
```
Samir Ortiz: I'll wire a one-click calendar + a 1-question micro-survey: "What's the top blocker right now? (one line)". store answer as ticket tag.
Leo Chen: Downgrade policy draft: preserve data/config, rollback within 30 days, auto-schedule enablement within 3 business days. keeps risk low.
Maya Patel: Feedback capture: post-call micro-survey -> tag ticket with `cs_conservation` and `renewal_date` for reporting.
Arjun Singh: Accounting Q: prefer prorated credit vs discount. propose single-month prorated credit for clarity. finance sign-off if >$5k.
Samir Ortiz: fine. we'll add finance checkpoint for >$5k.
Leo Chen: I'll spin up a lightweight dashboard: conservation pipeline by stage (detected, contacted, in-decline, accepted downgrade, recovered). want it live by Friday.
Maya Patel: Owners: @Arjun checklist + triage script, @Leo dashboard, @Samir downgrade policy + calendar link, I'll run outreach/runbook. will post runbook draft in this thread.
CS Ops Bot: Reminder created — follow-up task assigned to Maya Patel in 48h.
Maya Patel: thanks all. short reversible plays > long discounts. :thumbsup:
